summary: First-contact record written by Mandel from a read-only reading of the session transcript and repository on 2026-10-20; the adversarial re-check of the headline numbers did not run (session limit), so every figure is the child's own and unverified. The child consolidated a sports prediction and exchange trading engine (sportsbot/, with Kalshi, Polymarket and Polymarket US clients, a paper venue with tape-verified fills, a fail-closed risk layer, a tighten-only allocator and a go-live doctor) and ran 18 pre-registered tests, of which 15 failed, one passed as an upper bound and was then corrected by a FAIL row, and the latest is inconclusive. Its measurements say the prices on Kalshi and Polymarket US are calibrated to within about a cent (sports buckets within +/-0.4c on 38,080 event-buckets), its Elo/Markov models carry no information the price lacks (Kalshi MLB beta +0.065, t 0.20, n 873; tennis model Brier 0.2589 vs market 0.2024), price-only taker strategies and their inverses both lose the toll (follow + fade sums to about -2.5%), resting-maker fills are adversely selected (34,454 Kalshi tennis fills, mean markout -0.00645 at 30 minutes), and Kalshi leads Polymarket US in play (beta +0.925 within 20 s, t 33) with no pre-game gap worth a fee (0 of 10,685 snapshots). The one positive number, +0.6 to +0.9c of CLV per fill for an order resting at the touch (Results 15 and 24, Kalshi NHL +0.67c [+0.61, +0.71] on 41 games), holds only under a front-of-queue fill rule; counting the queue in front, a $1 order filled 22% of the time at -0.24 +/- 0.31c on 16 NHL games and 17 of 1,634 times (1.0%) at -0.19c [-1.01, +0.04] on a second night of 39 games (5 games with fills, below the 15 pre-registered), so the queue test is INCONCLUSIVE and nothing is funded. No live order has been placed; the pre-registered $1 live fill-share test (200 fills or 30 days) waits on the operator's Kalshi RSA key and a local config copy, and the child expects it to measure rather than earn. The child's own open questions are the fill share of a new order, the untested improve-the-price variant (8 of 56 joins, roughly flat), Polymarket US fill behaviour with no public tape, and two forward records (the Fed/G10 >= 0.90 rule, and NO on tennis longshots at T-30).
learnings: A new $1 order that joins a real Kalshi queue almost never fills (about 1% of joins behind a median 988-contract touch) and the fills it gets are not positive; the touch edge belongs to whoever is first in line. | evidence: docs/QUEUE_ADJUSTED_TOUCH_RESULT_2026-10-19.md: 17/1,634 fills, 5 games, -0.19c [-1.01, +0.04]; addendum 3 (16 NHL games, 2026-10-14): 22% fill, -0.24 +/- 0.31c. Both nights below the pre-registered 15-games bar; verdict INCONCLUSIVE by the child's own rule.

Front-of-queue (at-or-through) touch CLV is positive on Kalshi for MLB/NHL/NFL/soccer, +0.28c to +0.93c per fill net of the maker fee, replicated three times. | evidence: docs/KALSHI_TOUCH_RESULT_2026-10-14.md (NHL +0.67c [+0.61, +0.71], 41 games); EDGE_VERDICT Result 24 (MLB +0.80c [+0.70, +0.92], 396 games); QUEUE result FRONT row +0.28c [+0.12, +0.44], 25 games.

Kalshi leads Polymarket US (and international Polymarket) in play, the follower closes ~93% of the gap within 20 s, and pre-game there is no cross-venue gap worth a fee; complement arbitrage fails. | evidence: docs/PMUS_KALSHI_RESULT_2026-10-14.md: beta +0.925 t 33.4 (in-play, 20 s); 0 of 10,685 pre-game snapshots with a >=1c net lock, best -1.42c; CLAUDE.md summary of PRs #31-#39 (pooled 90-s estimate +0.126 +/- 0.024, t 5.3, Kalshi never follows).

Kalshi and Polymarket US sports prices are calibrated to within about a cent; in-house Elo/Markov models carry no information the price lacks; favourite-longshot and 'buy the favourite' trades lose the toll. | evidence: docs/SURVEY_2026-10-01.md (sports within +/-0.4c, 38,080 event-buckets); EDGE_VERDICT Results 2/5/6/8/9 (beta +0.065 t 0.20; tennis model Brier 0.2589 vs market 0.2024; favourites -0.4% [-4.2%, +3.5%]); docs/PMUS_SURVEY_2026-10-12.md.

Price-only intraday strategies on Kalshi (taker momentum, mean reversion, flow, following a venue) lose roughly the round-trip toll, and inverting them loses the toll too (follow + fade sums to about -2.5%). | evidence: docs/STRATEGY_LAB_2026-09-29.md (follow -3.2% / fade +0.6% / sum -2.6%; fresh 70 games: both lose); docs/SURVEY_2026-10-01.md (0 taker cells confirmed); addendum 3 taker screen (every rule loses net; gross signals +0.6-0.8 pt vs ~2.2 pt cost).

Resting-maker fills on Kalshi are adversely selected (median markout zero, mean negative, one-sided flow 84/16 on tennis), and LIP rewards do not cover fill losses (break-even share 0.23-0.70 vs 0.003-0.09 achievable). | evidence: docs/MARKOUT_2026-09-23.md; docs/LIP_HIST_2026-10-03.md (Mentions confirmation through-fill -$1,533, t -0.16).

The user's own trading (-13.4% of turnover) lost mostly on combos and table tennis; 'doing the opposite' would not have worked because both sides pay the toll; the only clear tilt is against tennis longshots (<0.15, -2.9 +/- 1.4c), now a forward test. | evidence: transcript page10 (10:53Z tallies); docs/PMUS_SURVEY_2026-10-12.md; docs/PREMATCH_FORWARD_PREREG_2026-10-12.md (pass: n >= 150, mean net > 0, t >= 2).

Being first at a new best price (improve: true, spread >= 2 ticks) is the one touch variant still unmeasured: 14% fill, roughly flat. | evidence: docs/QUEUE_ADJUSTED_TOUCH_RESULT_2026-10-19.md NEW-PRICE row: 8/56, +0.14c [-0.26, +0.53], 6 games; addendum 3: 41 joins, 68%, +0.07 +/- 0.12c.

Kalshi's hourly S&P/Nasdaq-100 and BTC/ETH ladders are not slow to their underlying; the book beats a lognormal on the index by t ~ 8 and the model side loses 3.6 points per contract. | evidence: EDGE_VERDICT Result 22 (5,597 settled events, kalshi-engine/src/index_hourly_study.py) and 21d (328 events each for KXBTCD/KXETHD).

The Fed decision-bucket rule (buy >= 0.90 within a week) paid 18 of 18 FOMC meetings (+2.1% at 24h, +3.4% at 168h net of 1c); the 15-bank version lost (-0.7%), and the G10 split was drawn after the losses were seen. | evidence: CLAUDE.md 'What resolved data says about edges'; EDGE_VERDICT Result 20; arb-scanner fed_watch/cb_watch forward recorders.
